participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Empathetic and creative, always looking for ways to help others and express myself through music.
participant_1.background: I volunteer at the homeless shelter. I enjoy exploring new parts of the city. I play several instruments. My father played violin professionally. I'm a piano teacher on the side.

participant_2.personality: Practical and down-to-earth, I find joy in simple tasks and have a strong sense of responsibility.
